name: Multiphase Uniform Alpha 10x10
description: 2D quiescent (zero velocity) square cavity, two-phase (water/air) mixture with a uniform initial volume fraction -- 10x10 structured Cartesian mesh. P6-PHYS-002: the first production physics.json case to exercise multiphase transport end to end through CaseReader/CaseBuilder/ProjectRunner. With zero mass flux everywhere, the volume-fraction convection contribution is identically zero, so alpha is exactly preserved by the single VolumeFractionSolver step -- the production-path analogue of tests/integration/multiphase/test_uniform_alpha.cpp's own equation-level validation.
